repaired_findings.summary: Mattis et al. 2025 citation used the wrong DOI/pages and incomplete authorship in the M1.E3 copy.
repaired_findings.resolution: Corrected to DOI 10.1093/joc/jqaf019, pages 437-449, and the five-author publication record.

repaired_findings.summary: Nickl preprint access_url pointed to a conference presentation page rather than the canonical preprint route.
repaired_findings.resolution: Access URL normalized to the DOI route while retaining the preprint evidence status.

repaired_findings.summary: Alvarado sample metadata collapsed several distinct analysis bases into recruited/analyzed only.
repaired_findings.resolution: Preserved achieved-panel, consent/screening, treatment-distribution and complete-case regression Ns plus representativeness caveats.

repaired_findings.summary: Upworthy causal-use limitation did not record the exact scale/period of the archive randomization problem.
repaired_findings.resolution: Recorded 7,004 tests (22%) and the affected 2013-06-25 through 2014-01-10 interval, while retaining the reliable-subset robustness note.

repaired_findings.summary: Nexp, B and W definitions could be read as persisted runtime states despite different M0 implementation semantics.
repaired_findings.resolution: Definitions now distinguish conceptual event count from stored state and decision-time computed quantities from persisted AgentState fields.

repaired_findings.summary: LR range metadata visually admitted zero while executable code correctly rejects LR <= 0.
repaired_findings.resolution: Added an explicit strict-positive range note and aligned the definition with executable preconditions.

repaired_findings.summary: Source-level metadata corrections require a new evidence metadata revision rather than claiming the r1 snapshot is unchanged.
repaired_findings.resolution: Advanced to EVIDENCE.M1.2026-09-21.r2 while explicitly retaining the same evidence set and unchanged model equations/benchmark results.

repaired_findings.summary: Canonical STATUS text still stated that the evidence snapshot was unchanged after the source-level content audit advanced metadata from r1 to r2.
repaired_findings.resolution: STATUS now distinguishes an unchanged evidence set from the explicitly versioned metadata revision EVIDENCE.M1.2026-09-16.r1 -> EVIDENCE.M1.2026-09-21.r2.

repaired_findings.summary: The generic study field event_count conflated non-equivalent design units across experiments: seven news events in Tohidi, four countries in Aruguete, and an incorrect value of two for an Alvarado design containing eight randomized posts.
repaired_findings.resolution: Replaced event_count with an explicit design_structure array. Tohidi records 7 events and 3 frames; Aruguete records 4 country experiments and 2 primary frame arms; Alvarado records 8 posts from 2 candidates × 2 claim contents × 2 frame types.

repaired_findings.summary: Preregistration was stored only as a boolean for survey experiments, obscuring where and how the claim was verified.
repaired_findings.resolution: Added study-level preregistration notes: Tohidi/AsPredicted, Aruguete/OSF, and Alvarado/OSF with the source-documented field-date typo qualification.

repaired_findings.summary: A single preregistered=true flag for Alvarado could be read as claiming preregistration of the Confirmation × Partisan Alignment target analysis, although the supplementary file states those interaction models were added during revision at Reviewer 1's request.
repaired_findings.resolution: Replaced the ambiguous survey-study preregistration field with study_preregistered plus target_analysis_registration_status. Alvarado is now STUDY preregistered but its CBD target analysis is explicitly POST_HOC_REVIEWER_REQUESTED; Tohidi and Aruguete targets remain PREREGISTERED.

repaired_findings.summary: The generic n_analyzed field could be misread as the N of a single statistical model. This was especially misleading for Aruguete, where 9,512 is the sum of four country experiments and the retained effects are country-specific.
repaired_findings.resolution: Added analysis_base_note to every survey target, explicitly distinguishing the results base used by each registered effect and warning that Aruguete's 9,512 is not a pooled regression N.

repaired_findings.summary: Aruguete reports both main-text unadjusted substantive differences and adjusted Table 2 coefficients, creating a plausible future false-positive audit mismatch (18.2 pp versus about 18.8 pp in Argentina).
repaired_findings.resolution: Kept the existing CBD values because they match the source's main-text substantive differences and added an explicit effect_estimate_note distinguishing them from the adjusted Table 2 specification.

repaired_findings.summary: LINK.CONGRUENCE.ENGAGEMENT cited the Alvarado experimental interaction without recording that the specific Confirmation × Partisan Alignment models were added during peer-review revision.
repaired_findings.resolution: Added the registration-status qualification to the link's evidence limitations and marked the audit record VERIFIED_WITH_QUALIFICATION.

repaired_findings.summary: Two M0 scientific pattern tests were weaker than their registered claims: VAL.M0.003 injected reliability levels instead of testing learning, and VAL.M0.004 tested only reduced false sharing rather than true-versus-false sharing discernment.
repaired_findings.resolution: VAL.M0.003 now derives high/low reliability from feedback learning starting at the same baseline. VAL.M0.004 now compares the true-minus-false sharing-probability gap before and after the accuracy cue while retaining the false-sharing reduction check.

open_gaps.summary: ModelParams defaults are demonstrative, but arbitrary user-supplied alpha/beta values do not yet have a complete scientific admissibility contract. No unsupported bounds are invented in v0.1.1.
The evidence registry is a bounded snapshot, not a systematic review, meta-analysis, or calibration dataset.
Thirteen of twenty conceptual modules currently have no variables registered through variables.json; their presence is a roadmap, not executable coverage.
Event schedules remain externally supplied and Share does not generate future exposure; feedback closure is future research under Issue #110.
Synthetic recovery does not establish a human recognition architecture, identify Pencode, or authorize recruitment.
The retained participant-level aggregate representation does not preserve item identity; a crossed participant-item model requires a new prospective contract.

VAL.M0.002 is tested as a descriptive pattern and C -> B exists in computational dependencies, but links.json has no dedicated empirical correction-accessibility -> belief relation/reference. The exponential accessibility-decay implementation is not empirically identified by the current evidence set.

VAL.M0.003 and T -> B computational dependence exist, but links.json has no dedicated empirical reliability -> belief relation/reference. The current source_weight mapping is explicitly a modelling choice. Relevant external literature should enter only through a future versioned evidence refresh.

benchmark_artifacts.note: Core 200-replicate synthetic recovery design; trial-count grid, generators, regimes, threshold and selection rule were cross-checked against the authoritative CSV.
Controlled refinement changes only the trial-count axis relative to the core design; all listed refined cells are represented in the authoritative CSV.
Four allocations × three heterogeneity levels × two generators × three memory regimes define 72 screening cells at 50 replicates each.
The frozen confirmation surface contains 29 cells: all 18 P64_X10 primary cells plus 11 boundary minimum-with-ties cells, with screening recovery values matching the screening CSV.
Nine misspecification profiles × two generators define 18 Phase M cells at 200 replicates each; profile values remain demonstrative rather than population estimates.
24 rows; every row has 200 replicates, probabilities sum to 1, and the pass flag matches the 0.80 gate. Minimum recovery is 0.225.
18 rows across 480/640/960 trials per operating point; every row has 200 replicates, probabilities sum to 1, and every cell passes 0.80; minimum recovery is 0.835.
72 rows at 50 replicates; probabilities sum to 1 and all cells pass the screening threshold, with minimum recovery 0.88.

29 selected cells and 5,800 total replicates; selected counts reproduce reported probabilities, three wrong-family selections occur overall, and all 18 primary P64_X10 cells pass with minimum recovery 0.92.
18 cells and 3,600 total replicates; aggregate correct/wrong/inconclusive counts reproduce the header, the minimum recovery is 0.56, and exactly three EVSD cells fail the 0.80 formal gate.

validation_patterns.note: Descriptive pattern is a model evaluation target; passing the software/reference test is not equivalent to population-level empirical validation.

The descriptive correction/regression pattern is scientifically plausible and consistent with the broader correction literature, but CBD r2 does not yet register a dedicated correction-accessibility -> belief empirical link/reference. The specific exponential accessibility-decay bridge remains a model construct and must not be presented as empirically identified.

The descriptive source-reliability weighting phenomenon has external experimental support, but CBD r2 does not yet register a dedicated reliability -> belief empirical link/reference. The executable source_weight mapping (2T-1), including evidence-sign reversal below T=0.5, is a model choice rather than an established psychological law.
